description: A stand-in for Firecrawl's keyless MCP server (mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp): its scrape answers the ticket page as drawn in a browser, in Firecrawl's own result shape. The page is made up for this case.

firecrawl_scrape.description: Scrape one URL and return its content: markdown by default, or HTML, links, screenshots, branding data, or a targeted answer. Use it when the request identifies a page and needs its content or defined fields. `url` may omit the scheme (`example.com/page`); it is read as https.

objective.description: The user's underlying goal for this call, in one sentence: what they are ultimately trying to accomplish, not a restatement of the URL or query.
